title: LA Craft Outdoor – Cloisonné · Huangshan Sea of Clouds
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Chinese woman in her early 40s, black hair in a high sleek bun with a gold hairpin, natural face with a composed smile.

Physique: Heavily oversized SuperBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE — colossal soft belly hanging in deep rolling folds, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust, extremely wide hips, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms.

Body Art: Full body cloisonné enamel body painting in Ming jingtailan style, from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, no collar band. Glossy turquoise enamel base divided by raised gold wire outlines, filled with lotus scrolls, peonies, and cloud bands in coral red, cobalt, and white. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Standing on a stone terrace in a soft three-quarter front view, gentle weight shift, both hands resting lightly on her belly, gazing toward the camera. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Turquoise enamel platform T-strap stiletto sandals with raised gold wire outlining every strap and a gold ankle buckle, 8-inch platform stilettos. Nails: turquoise with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: Huangshan cliff terrace above a sea of clouds, pine silhouettes and pale mist, no other people. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame, low camera angle, 135mm lens. Soft morning light through mist with gentle raking side light making the gold wires glint. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
